correctness.rationale: The verifier rebuilds the 12-vertex 24-edge cube line graph, exactly 516 disconnected induced five-sets, 2,974 faces and 15,576 Hasse covers; both directed matching DAGs are exhaustively acyclic. Forward Morse critical cells (one 0-cell, fifteen 5-cells, 121 6-cells) yield a rank-three integer differential with determinant +1 on rows/columns (0,1,6). Reverse matching leaves one 0-cell, thirteen 5-cells and 119 6-cells, rank-one unit minor. The integral differential has all nonzero Smith factors units and determines null/primitive attaching degrees on wedges of five-spheres, so cancellations prove the integral sphere wedge. Independent F2 boundary ranks 462,398 check the resulting Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedron is a canonical symmetric Archimedean graph, expressible as the cube line graph. A complete exact homotopy classification at natural cut size five provides integral Betti ranks in two adjacent dimensions and a non-shellability obstruction absent from existing cut-size-three knowledge. The extra attaching-degree certificate supplies substantial structural information beyond a face count or Euler characteristic; no downstream general theorem is required for a motivated complete finite classification.
